title: Threshold Composition Representation
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f:\{−1,1\}^n\to\{−1,1\}$, and let $p:\{−1,1\}^n\to\mathbb R$. Suppose $f(x)=1$ when $p(x)\geq0$ and $f(x)=-1$ when $p(x)<0$. Then $f$ is a threshold of $(2n)s$ linear threshold functions, where $s$ is the number of nonzero Fourier coefficients of $p$ on the Boolean cube.
hypotheses_covered: $p$ is a real-valued function on the Boolean cube
$f$ is the threshold sign of $p$ at every input
